privacy.title: Privacy and data sharing
privacy.gistMessage:
Recipient: GitHub ({recipient})

Sharing uploads the current document, its generated HTML and embedded images to a Secret Gist using your GitHub token. Anyone with the link can access the shared content; a Secret Gist is not a private encrypted document. Copies already shared cannot be recalled by Mark2.

Allow sharing with GitHub? You can withdraw consent in Settings.
privacy.permissionRequired: Data sharing was not authorized. Review the information or reset sharing consent in Settings before trying again.
privacy.revoked: Saved sharing permissions have been cleared. Future AI and Gist requests require consent again. Requests already in progress and data already sent are not recalled.
privacy.summary:
Documents and workspace data are processed locally. Files outside the app container require macOS permission.

AI features transmit prompts, relevant text, conversation history and API credentials to the provider you configure after you authorize sharing. Automated suggestions also send relevant context. Changing the service recipient requires new consent.

Gist sharing uploads the current document and embedded images to GitHub after authorization. Anyone with the resulting link can read the shared content.

Use Settings to withdraw future sharing consent. To delete data already sent to a third party, follow that service’s policies. GitHub builds check for updates using the Mark2 update service; Mac App Store builds update through the store.
